news.headline: Jim Cramer sends a strong signal to Google stock investors
news.summary: Cramer is not done with Google. And he has a chartist to back him up.

news.headline: Her $420,000 in Employer Stock Inside Her 401(k) Lost 11% in a Day. Rolling It Into an IRA Would Turn Her Long-Term Gain Into Ordinary Income
news.summary: A retiree sitting on a big Broadcom position in her 401(k) is one routine rollover form away from a tax bill she never saw coming. A little-known IRS rule offers another route, but the window to use it is narrow.

news.headline: Google’s 2027 chip plan is bad news for Broadcom
news.summary: A top supply-chain analyst says Google is changing what it buys, and Broadcom’s higher-priced chip is taking most of the hit.

news.headline: Google Backs Superhot Geothermal in 50 MW Oregon Power Deal
news.summary: Google signed a 50 MW power deal with Quaise Energy for superhot geothermal in Oregon, but the drilling technology still has to prove it can scale.

news.headline: Billionaire David Tepper’s Appaloosa Opened a $172 Million Stake in Oracle
news.summary: Appaloosa bought Oracle before the stock lost nearly half its value this year, but a 13F filing hides the details that matter most. What can retirement investors actually learn from a bet they can't copy?

news.headline: Alphabet vs. Meta Platforms: Which Media Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Alphabet's 13.9x forward P/E sits well below Meta's 20.5x, but Meta's 27.5% revenue jump makes the growth-versus-value trade-off harder to call.
